description: Use this when a Phorme coach wants to see what their members really ask their AI coach, to review or rate it. It returns recent questions with the coach's answer and whether it was corrected, with names, numbers, emails, links and handles removed. It reads only. It needs a connected Phorme account that owns the brain.

brain_id.description: The brain id of the coach's own build, for example "cameron".

name: student_questions
title: Get my students' questions
